release_notes:
LinguaFast v1.14.0 (build 14). In-place signed update from v13 with the same Android package ID and signing certificate.

Changes: larger original-text entry area; clearer Mic, Listen, Paste and Clear controls below the editor; clears source text on language/direction switch with Restore Previous; saves unfinished drafts and existing history/preferences locally; clearer free translation service error messages; GitHub release notes visible in the update screen.

Notes: the v14 APK reuses v13's native compiled bridge. Clipboard Paste can require using the Android keyboard's Paste command, and the updater download may hand off to the system browser/downloads rather than staying inside LinguaFast. The updated native in-app downloader source is not yet included in this APK. Android's system installer must approve installation. Normal signed upgrades preserve existing app storage.
